repo.description: Git URL or path for the skills pool repository

ref.description: Git tag, branch, or commit SHA

installMode.description: Optional install mode metadata. Projection is release-safe; copy is explicit compatibility. Symlink is not valid in public/release lockfiles.

path.description: Project-relative POSIX path to the skill-sys.sources.lock.json evidence file

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source-lock file bytes bound at bootstrap time

entryName.description: Selected source-lock entry name that must match this lockfile's repo/ref/sourceCommit

sourceLock.description: Optional corroborating source-lock evidence binding. Policy commit/checksum/projection pins remain the independent trust authority; install verifies these bytes and bindings before mutation.

minPoolVersion.description: Minimum skill-sys package version required by this lockfile

requireRefExists.description: Require the configured ref to exist in remote repo before install (default true)

requireSignedTag.description: Require lockfile ref to be a valid signed git tag

requireSourceCommit.description: Require the configured ref to resolve to sourceCommit

sourceCommit.description: Expected full source commit SHA for the configured ref

expectedSourceSha256.description: Expected source package checksum from release artifact

requireSourceChecksum.description: Require expectedSourceSha256 to be present and verified

requireProjectionDigests.description: Require expectedProjectionDigests to pin canonical and provider projection output

expectedProjectionDigests.description: Expected canonical and provider projection digest pins for lockfile installs

requireReleaseManifest.description: Require the release manifest to be present and match the source tree

releaseTag.description: Release tag used to locate release manifest and skill BOM artifacts

releaseManifestPath.description: Optional relative path to the release manifest inside the pool root

expectedReleaseManifestSha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the release manifest file

requireSkillBom.description: Require the skill BOM to be present and match the source tree

skillBomPath.description: Optional relative path to the skill BOM inside the pool root

expectedSkillBomSha256.description: Expected SHA-256 of the skill BOM file

requireCosignBundles.description: Reserved provenance gate; current local verifier fails closed when required

cosign.description: Reserved Cosign identity policy; unsupported by the current local verifier

requireGithubAttestation.description: Reserved provenance gate; current local verifier fails closed when required

githubAttestation.description: Reserved GitHub attestation policy; unsupported by the current local verifier

allowGlobalCoreProjectSkills.description: Allow installs to include bundled global-core project skills when explicitly requested by policy
